intro.text: The question mark (?) is Shift and slash. The exclamation mark (!) is Shift and 1 – a long reach up for your left little finger.
intro.tip: Hold the right Shift for !, and the left Shift for ?.

steps.title: Meet question mark and exclamation mark
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: ?? !! yes? no! why? wow! really? great!
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: Are you ready? Yes! Can we go now? Of course! What a brilliant idea! Who wants a snack?
Did you hear that? It was thunder! Shall we stay inside? Good plan! Where is the torch?
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
